response.original_title: Qué lejos están las fuentes y los pájaros
response.overview: A child touches an insect and, unknowingly, sets in motion a journey: birds and fountains guide the transformation of a world that forms and dissolves. Among the vestiges of a fading splendor, the forces of the earth persist, and everything returns, like an echo, between what was and what will never be again.
response.title: Qué lejos están las fuentes y los pájaros
